sourcesContent: import { Component, signal } from '@angular/core'; @Component({ selector: 'app-investment-toggle', standalone: true, imports: [], templateUrl: './investment-toggle.html', styleUrl: './investment-toggle.css', }) export class InvestmentToggle { active = signal<'lumpsum' | 'sip'>('sip'); setActive(tab: 'lumpsum' | 'sip') { this.active.set(tab); } }
